name: DZPOWER
tagline: Mandole, qanun, gasba, ghaita, organ, strings and drums: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Algerian plucks, reeds, organ, strings and drums
gumroad_title: DZPOWER - Raï & Chaabi Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Oriental, Afrotrap, Trap
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight engines inspired by Algerian popular music (mandole, qanun, gasba, ghaita, raï organ, chaabi strings, derbouka and bendir sub) and 70 factory presets.
about: DZPOWER, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a resonant multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
55 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices; the 15 others (all Bendir Sub & Bass presets plus a few lead sounds) load in Mono mode for single-note lines.
Built for Raï and Raï'n'B, Chaabi, Oriental pop, Afrotrap, Hip-Hop and Trap: plucked hooks, reed leads, organ and string chords, hand-drum percussion and deep subs.

features.d: Mandole, qanun, gasba, ghaita, raï organ, chaabi strings, derbouka and bendir sub.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from mandole plucks to bendir subs.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated ADSR.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 36 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: DZPOWER plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .dzpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
